parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck implement the specified PWM/serial jumper-selectable servo interface, power paths, battery switch, MAX3485 auto-direction control, and M5Stack bus pass-through with the expected component values and connectivity. Reference designators are renumbered relative to the specification, but the functional mapping matches the intended design; no deviation supported by the files was found.
